The '''Thul training camp''' was a military training camp for the forces of [[House of Thul|House Thul]] in [[King's Pass]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. It was located across a small lake from the [[Baliss staging grounds|staging grounds]] of [[House Baliss]].
